summary: The PR addresses an inconsistency in how the 'Other parameters' section is formatted compared to the 'Parameters' section, but introduces a potential behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The change modifies the behavior of the 'Other parameters' section without ensuring that existing documentation using this section will continue to render correctly. This could break existing behavior.
There are no additional tests added to verify the new behavior of the 'Other parameters' section when `napoleon_use_param` is True. The existing tests may not cover this specific case.
